name: git-commit
description: Draft concise Conventional Commit messages or commit staged changes, with prominent breaking-change warnings and approval before breaking commits.

interface.shortDescription: Draft messages or commit staged changes
interface.longDescription: Inspect only the current Git index, choose a concise Conventional Commit message, and commit on the current branch. Include draft for a message preview. Breaking changes receive a prominent warning, an explanation of their impact, and require explicit approval before committing or changing the index. Drafts also show breaking-change warnings. Mixed unrelated changes require a decision before splitting or committing, and the skill does not push.
defaultPrompt: Use Git Commit draft to propose a Conventional Commit message for my staged changes.
Use Git Commit to commit my staged changes on the current branch.
